fusions.name: Charging Fell
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and strike for 16 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cavalry Sweep
fusions.desc: A wide sweep that deals 30 damage to everything within 5 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Thunder Gait
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Rider's Cadence
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
